Cumberland Partners Ltd who had been investing in Hanesbrands Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.53 billion market cap company. (NYSE:HBI) has declined 8.16% since May 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.71% the S&P500.
Cumberland Partners Ltd, which manages about $759.83 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) by 95,075 shares to 104,420 shares, valued at $4.28 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Toronto Dominion Bank (NYSE:TD) by 102,821 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 573,734 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
